name: Return to Apothecary Zinge
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
"Here you go, the power source is safely removed and the data is preserved.  Well, safe journeys and all that.  Hope the nefarious science experiment worked out for you and all."

The goblin turns away from you to attend to the demands of the Gadgetzan Water Company.  You secure the sealed testing kit for the journey back to the Undercity.  Apothecary Zinge waits for you and the sealed field testing kit there.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Sealed Field Testing Kit to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I will analyze this data immediately. Perhaps Keever's insanity will prove to be my genius after all.

As for you... you are useful to me, and I reward quite well those who remain useful. Take this item, this coin, and most importantly my thanks along with them.

Check back with me from time to time - I wager that our working together on this project is not at an end.
narrative.requestItemsText: Welcome back. At least, welcome back if you have returned with a sealed testing kit. Otherwise, I will pretend not to notice your utter incompetence and spare my wrath from you until you do as you have been tasked and accomplish my task.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 45 to 46, 14,930 XP in all.

quests.name: Errand for Apothecary Zinge
quests.objectiveText: Take the purchase order to Alessandro Luca in the Undercity.

quests.name: Errand for Apothecary Zinge
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Field Sampling Kit to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.

quests.name: Into the Field
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan about getting a power source for the testing kit.

quests.name: Slake That Thirst
quests.objectiveText: Bring 5 Wastewander Water Pouches to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Tanaris Field Sampling
quests.objectiveText: Acquire acceptable samples for 8 basilisks, 8 hyenas, and 8 scorpions.

quests.name: Return to Apothecary Zinge
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Sealed Field Testing Kit to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.
